title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: one administration fee per approval date
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product one approval date carries at most one administration fee, as each charge code is booked once per charging date: when an administration-fee row is already dated on the handling date the fee is 0.00, and an approval recorded with a fee of 0.00 writes no administration-fee row. The fee is a whole tariff amount stated to two decimal places and is not rounded further. Otherwise the fee of the approval is the category's administration fee where the acceptance is under review and its booking allows the fee, and 0.00 where it does not.

## Truth table
| Administration-fee row already dated on the handling date | Acceptance under review, on a booking that allows the fee | Fee with the approval |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 0.00 — no row is written |
| no | yes | the category's administration fee |
| no | no | 0.00 — no row is written |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)
- Approved on 4 March with a fee, reopened after an amended declaration and approved again on 4 March: a row is already dated 4 March, so the second approval's fee is 0.00 and no row is written.
- Approved on 4 March, reopened and approved again on 9 March: no row is dated 9 March, so this rule does not bar a fee on 9 March.

## Points of judgement
- *Is a 0.00 administration fee shown as a row on the account?* No; an approval recorded with a fee of 0.00 writes no administration-fee row.
